purification_method: washed with distilled water until neutral pH, then dried at 353 K (after the KOH step)
activation_method: precursor pre-carbonized (PC) at 823 K for 1 h under N2 (0.5 Nl/min, 6.0 K/min) to biochar CG_PC; then KOH chemical activation: impregnated with KOH (1:1 mass ratio) in 100 mL distilled water, stirred 24 h at 353 K, dried at 373 K, heated at 1073 K for 1 h under N2 (0.5 Nl/min, 4.0 K/min)
source_location: SI p. 7 (si1-07.png), Fig. S7, 77 K panel (CG_PC_KOH)
notes: archive: figS7_77K.json; digitized p/p0 0.5919; Fig. S7 77 K panel (y-axis printed without unit, wt% as in the other panels); separate run: pressures and values coincide with the Fig. 5/6c adsorption points up to p/p0 0.66 within digitization error, but its points at p/p0 0.72 and 0.79 have no counterpart in Fig. 5, so it is not the same plotted data; the SI figure is cropped at p/p0 ~ 0.82; red Toth line bridged across markers before digitizing (see log); x calibrated on the 0.2 and 0.8 ticks (0.0 tick hidden by markers); pressure_bar = digitized p/p0 x 1 bar (p0 not printed; the paper states the H2 isotherms were collected up to 1 bar and Table 3 gives the p/p0 = 1 values as 1 bar); isotherm_point_count = markers visible in the cropped figure (about 4 in the merged low-pressure cluster); Micromeritics ASAP 2460 (volumetric); H2 pretreatment: vacuum P <= 1e-5 mbar (stored as 0.001 Pa) at 473 K (stored 199.85 C); duration not stated for H2 (12 h stated for the N2 porosimetry degassing); wt% convention W1 from 'expressed in wt% (weight percent of adsorbed gas per gram of adsorbent)' (p. 1031); Vsuper (0.7-2 nm) 0.161 cm3/g, %micro 100 (Table 2); Vultra (d<0.7 nm), Vmicro (d<2 nm) and Vmeso (2-50 nm) by NLDFT (slit pores) from N2 at 77 K; VT from N2 uptake at p/p0 0.995 (Table 2); BET range: p/p0 0.01-0.30 (BET correlation coefficient >0.9998; no consistency criteria stated); EDX (Table S3) wt%: C 89.9, O 9.3, Mg 0.1, K 0.7 (at%: C 92.5, O 7.2, Mg 0.0, K 0.2); average pore size 1.47 nm from Table S7 (method not stated); skeletal density 2.18 g/cm3 by He pycnometry; yield 19.80% (Table 1); precursor: spent coffee grounds (Coffea arabica, local coffee shop) dried at 378 K for 2 h, ground and sieved (<=0.5 mm)
